s: A company plans to migrate 1,200 VMware VMs to AWS over 12 months. There is no configuration management database, and the team does not know which VMs communicate with each other. The company is starting its first AWS migration in 2026. The migration team needs server inventory, utilization data, and network connection data to group VMs into applications and to plan move groups. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Install the AWS Application Discovery Service agent on every VM, and view network dependencies in AWS Migration Hub.
Install the AWS Application Migration Service replication agent on every VM, and infer dependencies from the replication traffic.

Deploy the AWS Transform discovery tool in the data center to collect inventory, performance, and network connection data, and use AWS Transform to analyze dependencies and generate application groupings and wave plans.
Enable NetFlow export on the core switches, and build dependency graphs in a self-managed graph database.

w.y: The AWS Transform discovery tool collects inventory, performance and network connection data on premises, and AWS Transform uses it to infer dependencies, group servers into applications and propose waves. It replaces the discovery path that is now closed to new customers and needs no custom tooling, giving the LEAST operational overhead.

o.A: Application Discovery Service and Migration Hub are closed to new customers since November 2025.
o.B: Application Migration Service replicates disks; it does not map server-to-server dependencies, and replicating everything early adds cost.
o.C: Correct: current managed discovery and dependency analysis for new migration customers.
o.D: Possible but requires building and operating custom tooling.
